metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: Konica Minolta PROFESSIONAL 160 for Color Print brochure (AB3 0407T02M6), April 2004, PDF page 4 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; RMS granularity 4). PDF sha256 76a229cf99f7b75d813afa1c907e9335c8544391de4a5da6c4890f94026da4e6. Data (c) Konica Minolta Photo Imaging, Inc. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/konica-pro160/konica_professional_160/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'none' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.083, green 0.089, mid 0.088, among those whose kodak_portra_endura neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through kodak_portra_endura at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [445.7, 22.7, 595.5, 49.5] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print kodak_portra_endura; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'weak' as the shipped still portrait negatives (Kodak Portra 160, Fujifilm Pro 160S).
Note: Negs has no Konica QA RA-4 print paper; refined against kodak_portra_endura as the portrait RA-4 reference paper.
Note: The 4-page 2004 brochure prints no RMS granularity; diffuse RMS granularity 4 (48 um aperture, D 1.0) is cross-verified from fresh-era datasheet compilations (cacreeks.com/films.htm and foto-35mm.narod.ru, matching Konica Centuria 100/200/400 = 4).
Relative axes: sensitivity y axis: Relative Speed (log) carries a 1.0 scale bar between the two horizontal gridlines and no tick values; the offset is arbitrary and D5 rescales every channel.
